scope: Exact development build 36d0c0d8: actual rtl8139, NT3.51, IDE. Baseline, after three NDIS-wrapper reset callbacks, after cable down/up, and fresh QEMU cold boot. Four complete TCP streams (4 MiB each direction) verified independently in guest logs, host server and PCI PCAP, including IP/TCP checksums. Both sessions normal safe-off/exact SYS readback. Not physical PCI hot-plug or universal hardware certification.
